title: 5th July 2024 @ 3:16pm - PDI Procedural Coaching
subtitle: Post-Removal Investigation — PDI Interview & LATAM Procedural Coaching
location: Arturo Merino Benítez International Airport (SCL), Santiago, Chile — Post-Removal Holding Area
classification: Attorney Work Product — Privileged and Confidential

cluster_A_dgac_procedural_explanation.summary: DGAC explains the removal procedure to the passenger: staff reports an issue, security is called, captain orders removal. DGAC emphasizes that PDI will now investigate and if the passenger is right, 'se va a corroborar.' Passenger expresses frustration: 'me espanta un poco que llegamos a todo esto sin confirmar la verdad.'

cluster_B_pdi_coaching_latam.summary: CRITICAL: Background conversation captured. PDI officials huddle with LATAM boss and accuser. They review camera footage and confirm no aggression. PDI instructs LATAM: file complaint individually ('como tu persona, NO COMO LATAM'), not as the airline. PDI: 'en las cámaras obviamente se va a ver que agresión... no hay.' 'pasajero disruptivo... no lo vi... no lo declaro.' LATAM boss asks about the legal basis: 'Sería por seguridad, porque no contribuyó?' PDI: 'Claro, nosotros podemos tomar tu denuncia, pero por otro hecho.' The coaching conversation reveals coordinated effort to reframe the complaint after cameras disproved the original allegation.

cluster_C_dgac_sympathy_and_deflection.summary: DGAC expresses sympathy: 'son malos ratos que los pasajeros no deberían pasar.' But deflects responsibility: 'esta decisión no la decidimos nosotros.' DGAC emphasizes their role is airport security, not decision-making — 'eso es directamente parte del capitán y de la personal de la compañería.'

cluster_D_passenger_explains_timeline.summary: Passenger explains the full sequence to PDI/DGAC: asked questions at boarding gate, staff got annoyed ('se picaron'), the flight was late but LATAM didn't inform passengers. Passenger states: 'no me hagan de estúpido, por favor.' PDI asks clarifying questions about the boarding process.

cluster_E_pdi_admits_no_case.summary: PDI officer admits this is a waste of time: 'para mi lo más fácil es deshacerme esto rápido.' Reveals knowledge that the accuser is lying: 'Él está llorando ya, que me pegaste, mentira.' PDI confirms cameras will be checked. Passenger asks for camera footage. PDI: 'Nosotros vamos a tratar de recuperarlo.' PDI explicitly states: 'Ellos pueden acusar lo que sea, la decisión la damos nosotros como policía, nosotros mandamos.' Passenger explains personal situation: divorce documents, daughter.

cluster_F_case_closed.summary: PDI wraps up: passenger needs to rebook flight with LATAM directly. PDI: 'es un tema entre particulares.' No charges filed against passenger. PDI notes system will show passenger arrived on time with no issues: 'no hai ninguna denuncia en tu contra.' PDI: 'aquí veo que hay detenciones.' Passenger asks for water. Recording ends.

key_evidentiary_findings.finding: PDI officials reviewed camera footage and confirmed NO aggression occurred: 'en las cámaras obviamente se va a ver que agresión... no hay.' This directly contradicts the basis for removal.
key_evidentiary_findings.cross_reference: F-003; STG_5 seg 5-7; STG_6 Phase A

key_evidentiary_findings.finding: PDI coached LATAM staff to reframe complaint: file individually ('como tu persona, NO COMO LATAM'), not as the airline. This suggests an effort to shield LATAM from liability while still pursuing the passenger.
PDI officer admitted the accuser was lying: 'Él está llorando ya, que me pegaste, mentira.' Direct acknowledgment by law enforcement that the original allegation was false.

PDI explicitly stated no charges: 'no hai ninguna denuncia en tu contra.' Passenger was removed from the flight, lost his connection, but faced no legal consequences — confirming removal was without legal basis.
DGAC admitted removal was based solely on airline/captain request, not independent verification: 'nosotros no somos los que decidimos si de usted lo bajamos o no.'
key_evidentiary_findings.cross_reference: STG_6 Phase H (DGAC: 'Los motivos los dio la compañía')

key_evidentiary_findings.finding: PDI confirmed passenger arrived on time and followed procedures: 'tu llegaste a la hora, que tu tuviste todo bien.' System record contradicts LATAM's claims.

LATAM boss and PDI discussed 'pasajero disruptivo' classification as alternative to aggression — a regulatory category that could justify removal even without physical aggression. PDI advised against it: 'no lo vi... no lo declaro.'
key_evidentiary_findings.cross_reference: ICAO disruptive passenger framework being discussed as fallback justification

key_evidentiary_findings.finding: Case classified as 'un tema entre particulares' — a private matter between passenger and airline. No criminal investigation opened.
